variant.name: Variant A — Stop Line
variant.status: proposal — for independent critique; not self-selected
variant.editorial_idea: The book is a walk that keeps being interrupted. The cover asks "Where Did You Last Stop?"; each section opens with a walk (the opening text) and ends on the sentence where the walker stops ("그래서 내 ○번째 이야기는 ○○이다"). Reading pages are the walk, picture pages are the stops.
variant.reader_experience: Reading pages are quiet and typographic: large thin section numeral, Korean text first, English beneath. Every few pages the reader is stopped by a full-bleed photograph with one line. One red rule marks only the sentence where each section stops, so the narrative spine (cover → 01 → 02 → 03) can be found by flicking.
variant.design_hypothesis: If the only recurring graphic device is a single red stop line placed under the sentence each section ends on, and text pages hold images to under 20 % of the page while bridge pages exceed 60 %, then the alternation of reading and stopping will make the book's verb — 멈춘다 — visible without any illustration or ornament.

differentiation_axes.editorial_hierarchy: Text-led. Section numeral > English question heading > Korean body > English translation. Photos are evidence beside the text, not the lead, except on bridge pages.
differentiation_axes.grid: 12 columns, asymmetric 7 + 5 split on reading pages (text 7, image/aside 5); 6 + 6 for paired Q blocks; bridge pages break the grid with a top bleed.
differentiation_axes.image_to_text_ratio: Measured image area / page area: cover 25 %, p1 19 %, p2 17 %, p3 69 %, p4 0 %, p5 30 %, p6 35 %, p7 60 %, back 68 %. Mean 36 %; reading pages (1, 2, 4, 5) mean 17 %.
differentiation_axes.typography_hierarchy: One sans family (Inter) at three weights for Latin: Thin for numerals, SemiBold for headings, Regular/Light for text. Hangul in one gothic face. No serif, no italics.
differentiation_axes.whitespace: Reserved, deliberate: the upper zone of a section opener is allowed to stay empty between the opening text and the stop line — the pause before the stop.
differentiation_axes.information_visualization: SECTOR A shows each style photo with the three colours sampled from it directly beneath, so the manuscript's observation (outfit colour follows the place) can be checked by eye, not just read.
differentiation_axes.visual_narrative: Walk (reading page) → stop (bridge page) → walk. The red stop line appears on the cover, p1, p4, p7 and the back cover only.

layout_rules: Korean first, English directly beneath in the same column, 7.5 pt, sub colour, 3 mm below. Never side by side.
The stop line (1.3 mm, colour stop) sits above the sentence a section stops on: cover question, p1, p4, p7, back cover. It is the only use of red.
On a section opener the stop sentence closes the upper zone: it sits on the zone's base, 12 mm above the Q rule; the space between the opening text and the stop line is left empty.
Paired questions sit on one 0.25 mm rule, cols 1–6 and 7–12, tops aligned.

Running head: top outer corner, 8 mm from trim, section mood word (STYLE / MOOD / PICTURE / MOMENT). Folio: bottom outer corner, 9 mm from trim, 'SPA · 0n SECTION' + page number on the outer side. Covers carry neither; the One To One page carries the page number only (02_picture.md).
Captions: 6.5 pt, below the image, aligned to the image's left edge; a short uppercase label then sentence case. On bridge pages the caption sits under the pull quote.
Full-bleed images extend 3 mm past trim; no text is set on an image. Pull quotes sit on paper beneath the bleed so their contrast does not depend on the photograph.
Every image slot carries its asset id. Until the original is placed it is drawn as a hatched, dashed-border placeholder with the id, subject and any measured values — never as a stand-in photograph.
Display type (≥ 18 pt) uses Inter Display; everything else Inter. No italics, no ornaments, no drop shadows on the page.

pages.composition: Masthead SPA across the full measure at the top. Below: the three subjects stacked in cols 1–4; the cover line in cols 6–12. IMG-01 inset cols 5–12 on white paper (cover.md: 흰 종이 위에서 가장 강하다). Bottom: name block cols 1–4; question with the first stop line cols 6–12.
Numeral 01 + STYLE label cols 1–7; opening text (A안) and stop sentence cols 1–7; IMG-02A runs the full upper zone in cols 8–12 with caption; Q1 | Q2 on one rule across the base.

pages.composition: Q3 (20 pt heading) cols 1–7; transition sentence as aside cols 9–12. SECTOR A across the base: four style photos, each with its three sampled colours beneath; attribute list cols 1–7, COLOR row with the five named chips cols 8–12; closing rule sentence.
Bridge. IMG-03 bleeds top to 206 mm. Pull quote "I stop for people whose style is their own." on paper below; caption = cover line, first two clauses.

Mirror of p1 on the outer side: numeral 02 + PICTURE cols 6–12, opening text and stop sentence cols 6–12, cols 1–5 empty in the upper zone (faces the bleed of p3). Q1 | Q2 on one rule across the base.
Q3 (20 pt heading) cols 1–7, Korean only (manuscript has no translation). MY PICTURE in the same form as SECTOR A: IMG-04 cols 1–7 to the base; field list cols 8–12, blanks shown as ____.
One To One: IMG-05 in the top 41 % of the page across the live area; the single word 웅덩이 at 96 pt, centred in the remaining space; page number only.
Bridge to 03. IMG-06 bleeds top to 178 mm; pull quote "Every good picture had a good place behind it."; closing Korean line; stop sentence 그래서 내 세 번째 이야기는 공간이다 at the base.
IMG-07 across the live area; the cover question returns with the last stop line, cols 5–12.

risks.risk: No photograph has been placed. Crops, tonal balance against the text, and the red stop line's relation to the real red light on the cover are all unverified.
Hangul is proofed in WenQuanYi Zen Hei. Line lengths, rag and the weight of the stop sentence will change with Pretendard / Noto Sans KR; re-run the checks after swapping.
p4 contains '앞 페이지의 사진도 그랬다' — valid only if the applicant took IMG-03 (02_picture.md note). If not, that sentence must be removed by the author, which shortens p4's opening.
Folios are numbered 1–7 in reading order; the manuscript's page map numbers the One To One page '+' and the bridge '6'. The final numbering is the author's decision.
Cover lists PICTURE; cover.md notes a storyline line reading 'SPA (STYLE, PASSION, ARCHITECTURE)' still to be confirmed.
SECTOR A colours were sampled from page captures, not originals; they are labelled approximate on the page.
Reading pages leave a deliberate empty band before the stop line. A reviewer may read it as unfinished rather than as a pause; this is the hypothesis under test.
The One To One manuscript suggests a mirrored 10 % ghost of the next word. Not drawn here: on thin stock the real show-through would double it. Decide after a paper test.
Brand: no Gentle Monster guideline was supplied. The variant uses no logo or brand typeface; if the portfolio must follow a brand template, the type roles need review.
Only 9 of the book's pages exist; 03 ARCHITECTURE (the section most relevant to the role) is not designed because no manuscript exists.
